builds.name: Reference: Physical pick
builds.goal: Reference for Shaco: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A deceptive skirmisher who attacks from behind, seeds fear traps and uses a clone to force poor target selection. Separate AD rear attacks from AP box/clone trap pressure. Clone/item interactions must be tested; do not grant every item or passive to both bodies at full value. Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
builds.summary: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Shaco: Separate AD rear attacks from AP box/clone trap pressure. Clone/item interactions must be tested; do not grant every item or passive to both bodies at full value.

Start with the early core (Youmuu, then Profane Hydra) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Shaco becomes Invisible and teleports to target location.

His first attack while Invisible is empowered, dealing bonus damage and critically striking if he attacks from behind. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Low health and defense; spell shields/proc cooldowns must be reset between tests.

The route fails Shaco's stated kit question: Separate AD rear attacks from AP box/clone trap pressure. Clone/item interactions must be tested; do not grant every item or passive to both bodies at full value.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Low health and defense; spell shields/proc cooldowns must be reset between tests.
Full cost 15,750 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Youmuu, then Profane Hydra. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Edge of Night, Serylda's Grudge, Guardian Angel are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

Active: Shaco throws a shiv, dealing [70 / 95 / 120 / 145 / 170 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.6) × AP] magic damage and Slowing by [(-0.2 / -0.225 / -0.25 / -0.275 / -0.3) × -100]% for [3] seconds. If the target has less than [30]% Health, the shiv deals [(70 / 95 / 120 / 145 / 170 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.6) × AP) × (1.5)] damage instead.

builds.name: Rear-shiv hybrid finish
builds.summary: Test an AP attack packet before a rear-facing low-health shiv.
builds.goal: Test an AP attack packet before a rear-facing low-health shiv.
builds.hypothesis: Backstab adds AP-scaled magic damage to rear E, enhanced below 30% health, and E itself has both AP and AD[statFormula=2] magic scaling. Lich Bane and Nashor supply real attack damage while Q enables the angle; Shadowflame targets the magic finish below 40%. W provides a fear window rather than assumed inherited on-hits.
testPlan: Required state: Q reaches the rear, target drops below 30%, and Spellblade is ready for the actual attack.
Separate rear attack/Q, E and passive rear-E packets above/below 30% health.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The target turns or shields above the threshold; AP sacrifices the physical Q opening.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Q forced crit follows its special formula, not an unrestricted ordinary crit multiplier.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Invisible box staging
builds.summary: Keep Q invisibility while placing W and R to prepare a delayed area trap.
builds.goal: Keep Q invisibility while placing W and R to prepare a delayed area trap.
builds.hypothesis: Q explicitly permits W and R without breaking invisibility. W takes two seconds to stealth and fires for five seconds once triggered; R detonation spawns mini boxes. AP supports those magic packets and Liandry/Bloodletter test burn and debuff application; Cosmic rewards confirmed magic contact for repositioning.
testPlan: Required state: Record box placement, arm time, clone lifetime and target movement through a prepared area.
Observe invisibility after W/R, then count box hits, burn refresh and MR debuff stacks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Enemies reveal or avoid boxes; clone dies out of range and setup time loses map pressure.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Boxes and clone are not automatically carriers of every owner item effect.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blackfire Torch, Liandry's Torment, Bloodletter's Curse, Cosmic Drive, Zhonya's Hourglass, Boots of Swiftness. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
